title: [TYPING] `function.mse_loss` stub misses `weight` argument
body:
The stubs for some `torch.nn.functional` members seem to be out of sync, for instance the `weight` argument is missing for `mse_loss`:

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/2b3ec34829036a65cd9d1398ea72a0167dc37470/torch/nn/functional.pyi.in#L600-L606

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/2b3ec34829036a65cd9d1398ea72a0167dc37470/torch/nn/functional.py#L4271-L4278
